title: Finding Equilibrium: The Science and Art of Balance
description: Explore the concept of balance from physical forces to life stability across all ages.
author: Curious Kelly

2-5.title: Wobble and Balance!
2-5.description: Learning to balance like a flamingo!
2-5.script: Hi friend! Look what I can do! I can stand on one foot! Whoa, wobble wobble! Balance is when we don't fall down. Did you know your ears help you balance? It's true! Let's try standing like a flamingo together!

teachingMoments.content: Kelly stands on one foot and wobbles.
Your inner ear has tiny helpers for balance.

6-12.title: The Science of Stability
6-12.description: How math and physics keep things steady.
6-12.script: Hey! Have you ever walked on a balance beam? It's all about physics! When things are equal on both sides, like a seesaw or a math equation, we call it 'equilibrium'. Your center of gravity is the secret code to staying upright!
objectives: Relate physical balance to math equations

teachingMoments.content: Center of gravity is your balance point.

en.welcome: Ready to explore the science of stability?

es.welcome: ¿Listo para explorar la ciencia de la estabilidad?
es.wisdomMoment: ¡Las matemáticas y el movimiento están conectados!

fr.welcome: Prêt à explorer la science de la stabilité?
fr.wisdomMoment: Les maths et le mouvement sont liés!

13-17.title: Physics in Motion
13-17.script: What's up? Whether you're skating or just walking, you're using physics. It's not just about staying still; it's about dynamic balance. We're talking torque, rotational inertia, and how your brain processes data from your vestibular system in milliseconds.

teachingMoments.content: Torque is the force that causes rotation.

en.welcome: Let's break down the physics of motion.

es.wisdomMoment: La física está dondequiera que te muevas.

fr.wisdomMoment: La physique est partout où tu bouges.

18-35.title: Finding Your Center
18-35.description: Homeostasis and equilibrium in a busy life.
18-35.script: Balance isn't a destination; it's a practice. In yoga, we learn that holding a pose requires constant micro-adjustments. Biologically, this is homeostasis—your body regulating temperature and energy. It's a perfect metaphor for managing career, health, and relationships.

es.wisdomMoment: El equilibrio es un proceso activo.

36-60.title: The Art of Juggling
36-60.script: At this stage, balance feels more like juggling, doesn't it? Supporting others while standing firm yourself. Nature does this through ecosystems, where every element relies on the others. We can learn a lot about resilience by observing how forests maintain their equilibrium.

en.welcome: Let's look at the bigger picture of balance.
en.wisdomMoment: You are the anchor in your ecosystem.

es.welcome: Miremos el panorama general del equilibrio.
es.wisdomMoment: Eres el ancla en tu ecosistema.

fr.wisdomMoment: Tu es l'ancre dans ton écosystème.

61-102.title: Wisdom in Motion
61-102.description: Flow, continuity, and the cycles of life.
61-102.script: True balance comes from flow, not force. Like in Tai Chi, we move with the energy, not against it. Over a lifetime, we see that highs and lows are just part of the same cycle. Peace is found in the center of the movement.

en.welcome: Let us share a moment of peace.
en.wisdomMoment: Flow with the river of life.

es.wisdomMoment: Fluye con el río de la vida.

fr.wisdomMoment: Coule avec la rivière de la vie.

choices.response: That's okay! Wobbling helps us find our center.

interactions.question: Which of these helps you balance the most?

choices.response: Eyes are important, but your ears do the heavy lifting!
Exactly! The vestibular system is amazing.

interactions.question: What happens if you close your eyes?

choices.response: Yes! Your brain has to rely 100% on your ears and muscles.
Usually it's harder, because vision gives us a horizon line!
